experiment_data.hypothesis: Scale validation: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (4-card TP=4) on MMLU shows item-related variance (item_id + model×item) >60% with same facet ranking as 7B-9B models, confirming G-theory variance structure is scale-invariant at the large-model end. If item_id% drops significantly at 72B scale, this reveals a scale-dependent variance boundary.
